description: mailbox.rs: role_to_wire(r) is called inside the .filter() closure of the matching iterator (lines ~242, ~456, ~653). Each call serializes the role to a serde_json::Value and then pattern-matches it to extract the String — allocating a new String per call. In the filter loop this runs once per mailbox per filter evaluation. The idiomatic fix: pre-compute the role string once outside the loop (let role_wire: Option<String> = role_filter.as_ref().map(role_to_wire)) and capture it by reference inside the closure. This avoids repeated heap allocations in the common case where the filter matches few mailboxes. The existing JMAP-yqo.13 finding notes the O(n) full-scan; this is an additional allocation cost within that scan.
title: role_to_wire called O(n) times in hot filter loop
